**Overview**: Osaka 2 nights, one base, no hotel change | light · standard · light
A short family break, so I've kept everything in one base and used the bay area (Kaiyukan) as the big family day. All times are approximate — please check opening hours and any timed tickets before you go.

**Before you go**
- Get IC cards (ICOCA, or any Suica/PASMO) at Kansai Airport — they work on Metro, JR and private lines.
- Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan: buy tickets online a few weeks ahead if you want a fixed entry slot (please check current rules).
- Many museums close on Mondays; temples and shrines usually close around 17:00 — please check.
- Early December evenings are cold and the Midosuji/Umeda winter illuminations are usually on — worth an evening stroll.
- Pack light layers; rain is possible, so keep one indoor option per day.

**Day 1 | Arrival · Namba / Dotonbori (light)**
- 13:00 Kansai Airport → Nankai rapi:t to Namba, approx. 40 min, no transfer
- 14:00 Check in at the hotel, rest and unpack
- 16:00 Walk approx. 10 min to Dotonbori: riverside stroll and street food for the family
- 18:00 Early dinner in Namba (kushikatsu or okonomiyaki), back to the hotel by approx. 20:00
- Tonight: Hotel Hankyu Respire Osaka [阪急大阪龙仕柏酒店]

**Day 2 | Bay area · Kaiyukan (standard)**
- 09:00 Midosuji Line to Hommachi, change to Chuo Line to Osakako, approx. 30 min, 1 transfer
- 09:45 Osaka Aquarium Kaiyukan — go early, it gets busy from late morning
- 12:30 Lunch at Tempozan Marketplace next door
- 14:00 Tempozan Ferris Wheel and harbour walk (optional, weather permitting)
- 16:30 Return to the hotel, rest
- 18:30 Dinner near Umeda; Umeda Sky Building observatory at sunset if the family still has energy
- Alternatives: if rain, swap the Ferris Wheel for the Kaiyukan's indoor exhibits plus the marketplace; if tired, drop the Umeda Sky Building and eat near the hotel
- Tonight: Hotel Hankyu Respire Osaka [阪急大阪龙仕柏酒店]

**Day 3 | Osaka Castle · departure (light)**
- 09:00 Check out, leave luggage at the hotel
- 09:30 JR Osaka Loop Line to Osakajokoen, approx. 15 min, no transfer — castle park and outer moat walk (keep the castle interior optional)
- 11:30 Back to the hotel, collect luggage, lunch nearby
- 13:00 Osaka Station → JR Haruka from Tennoji or the airport bus from Umeda to Kansai Airport, approx. 60–70 min; leave plenty of time for check-in (please check the exact departure point and times)

**Hotel notes**: I recommended the Umeda hotel because it sits on the main transit hub with quad rooms, which keeps transfers short with a family. If you'd rather be next to Universal Studios Japan, the Oriental Hotel Universal City has family rooms and kids' facilities at a lower price — say the word and I'll rebuild the days around it.

items.summary: Umeda (Kita) base right by Osaka Station — the easiest hub for a short family trip; quad rooms available.
